# Apply Xenium mapping to XeniumCleaned Xen1 dataset
```{r}
annotations_df <- data.frame(
  "Cell ID" = rownames(xenium_clean@meta.data)
)

annotations_df$Annotation <- sapply(
  xenium_clean$cell_type,
  function(xenium_type) {
    
    matching_types <- names(xenium_mapping)[
      sapply(xenium_mapping, function(types) {
        xenium_type %in% types
      })
    ]
    
    if (length(matching_types) == 0) {
      "Unassigned"
    } else {
      paste(matching_types, collapse = "; ")
    }
  }
)

table(annotations_df$Annotation)

table(annotations_df$Annotation == "Unassigned")


```

# Export for XeniumExplorer
```{r}
write.csv(
  annotations_df,
  "info/xenium_manual_scRNAseq_annotations.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```


```{r}
get_gene_detection <- function(
    seurat_obj,
    cell_type,
    cell_type_column = "cell_type",
    assay = NULL
) {
  
  if (is.null(assay)) {
    assay <- DefaultAssay(seurat_obj)
  }
  
  cells <- WhichCells(
    seurat_obj,
    expression = .data[[cell_type_column]] == cell_type
  )
  
  counts <- GetAssayData(
    seurat_obj,
    assay = assay,
    layer = "counts"
  )[, cells, drop = FALSE]
  
  Matrix::rowSums(counts > 0) / ncol(counts)
}

reference_types <- unique(reference$cell_type)

gene_detection <- lapply(
  reference_types,
  function(ct) {
    
    detection <- get_gene_detection(
      reference,
      ct
    )
    
    data.frame(
      Gene = names(detection),
      Cell_Type = ct,
      Detection_Frequency = as.numeric(detection),
      NotExpressed = detection < 0.05,
      Expressed = detection >= 0.10
    )
  }
)

gene_detection_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(gene_detection)

# Restrict to 480 gene Xenium panel
gene_detection_panel <- gene_detection_df %>%
  filter(Gene %in% xenium_genes)
```

```{r}
export_gene_detection <- function(
    seurat_obj,
    cell_type,
    xenium_genes,
    output_file,
    cell_type_column = "cell_type",
    assay = NULL
) {
  
  if (is.null(assay)) {
    assay <- DefaultAssay(seurat_obj)
  }
  
  # Get cells belonging to this reference cell type
  cells <- WhichCells(
    seurat_obj,
    expression = .data[[cell_type_column]] == cell_type
  )
  
  # Get counts
  counts <- GetAssayData(
    seurat_obj,
    assay = assay,
    layer = "counts"
  )[, cells, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Detection frequency
  detection <- Matrix::rowSums(counts > 0) / ncol(counts)
  
  # Restrict to Xenium panel
  detection <- detection[names(detection) %in% xenium_genes]
  
  # Make dataframe
  results <- data.frame(
  Gene = names(detection),
  Detected_Cells = as.integer(Matrix::rowSums(counts > 0)[names(detection)]),
  Total_Cells = ncol(counts),
  Detection_Frequency = as.numeric(detection),
  Detection_Percent = as.numeric(detection) * 100,
  Category = dplyr::case_when(
    detection < 0.05 ~ "NotExpressed",
    detection >= 0.10 ~ "Expressed",
    TRUE ~ "Intermediate"
  )
)

  
  # Sort by detection frequency
  results <- results[
    order(-results$Detection_Frequency),
  ]
  
  # Export
  write.csv(
    results,
    output_file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  return(results)
}
```

# Export by cell type
```{r}
dir.create("Xenium_gene_detection", showWarnings = FALSE)

reference_types <- unique(reference$cell_type)

for (ct in reference_types) {
  
  safe_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", ct)
  
  export_gene_detection(
    reference,
    cell_type = ct,
    xenium_genes = xenium_genes,
    output_file = file.path(
      "Xenium_gene_detection",
      paste0(safe_name, "_Xenium_gene_detection.csv")
    )
  )
}
```
